behavior: Mobile landscape match uses the available viewport, with safe-area padding, a larger arena and ten touch controls of at least44 CSS pixels.
Controls show icons and short Spanish labels; platform drop is available. Special and super show energy/unlock availability.

Independent finger, keyboard and gamepad sources prevent one release from cancelling a different held source. Pointer cancellation, capture loss, pause, orientation, page hiding and blur clear held controls.
Fullscreen targets the persistent application root so controls and help remain available. Supported devices attempt landscape lock directly from the start/ready gesture.
Unsupported fullscreen/lock does not block landscape play. Portrait shows a rotation prompt and freezes local/CPU simulation; online explicitly explains that the match continues.
Keyboard-oriented hybrid desktops retain the existing desktop layout.
Touch controls are absent during introduction, pause and results. Short results use a deliberately scrollable overlay with44px action targets.
Home-screen manifest declares landscape preference; no offline capability is claimed.

references.title: Fullscreen user activation and API support

limitations: No physical Android/iPhone/tablet hardware was tested.
Actual touch dispatch and fullscreen were checked in Chromium mobile emulation; WebKit/Safari was not run.
Safe-area padding is implemented; physical screen cutouts were not tested.
Resource unlocking used three character wins in an isolated review profile. Super energy came from real gameplay regeneration; no match physics was mocked.
Manifest orientation and Screen Orientation API remain browser-dependent; manual rotation is an intentional fallback.
